input: Arrange a caricature artist for the office holiday party

gold.taskTitle: Book a Caricature Artist for Office Holiday Party
gold.taskDescription: Arrange and confirm a professional caricature artist to perform at the upcoming office holiday party.

questions.title: What is the exact date and time of the party?
questions.description: Pinpoint the event date and time window so artist availability can be checked.

questions.title: How many guests are expected to attend?
questions.description: Determine the headcount to figure out how many artists are needed and how long they should perform.

questions.title: What is your budget for the caricature artist?
questions.description: Establish a spending limit to filter suitable artists and packages.

questions.title: Where is the party venue located?
questions.description: Get the city or specific venue address to find local artists or account for travel costs.

questions.title: Should the caricatures be digital, paper, or either?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred medium so the right type of artist and equipment can be sourced.

questions.title: Do you already have any artists in mind or need sourcing?
questions.description: Find out whether the user has leads to follow up on or needs a full search from scratch.

questions.title: Who needs to approve the booking before it is confirmed?
questions.description: Identify the decision-maker or approval process to avoid delays at the contracting stage.
